Hi, I'm Ayaan

Co-founder/CTO at Crossroads and a maintainer of OpenClaw (~383k ⭐). Former Google Summer of Code contributor with CERN on the ALICE experiment. Into scalable systems, performance work, bots, embedded tinkering, and aircraft.

Projects I Built

Systems & tools

  • 📻 chanson.live: Ultra-low-latency WebRTC radio for listening together without noticeable desync.
  • 🔒 agentwall: macOS sandbox for AI coding agents with file and network approval controls.
  • 🖥️ shelleport: Browser-based remote control for AI coding sessions on any machine.
  • 🤖 SuperSeriousBot: Telegram bot with APIs and chat-management features, used by 5,000+ people.
  • 🖼️ musee: Fast self-hosted image gallery that ships minimal JavaScript.
  • ⚡ pong: TUI that pings AWS regions around the world and shows the latency spread.
  • 🐍 uvlift: Interactive dependency updater for Python projects using uv.
  • 📚 anki-mcp: CLI MCP server for Anki via AnkiConnect.
  • 💸 ynab-mcp: CLI MCP server for YNAB.
  • 📝 codex-changelog: Release-to-post automation for openai/codex changelogs.
  • 🧾 india-tax: Simple India income-tax calculator comparing the current and proposed regimes.

For the fun of it

  • ✈️ pilane-web: DIY plane-spotting project using YOLO and an old Android phone.
  • 🎮 playtime-panorama: Dense, responsive collage of your Steam library with tile sizes driven by playtime.
  • 🗳️ gotm-remix: Game of the Month voting site for the Patient Gamers Discord server.
  • 🏎️ HamVerBot: F1 bot for #f1 on Libera.Chat.
  • 🎞️ trilbys-archive: Searchable archive of Zero Punctuation and Fully Ramblomatic transcripts.
  • 💉 vnb: Rust Telegram bot for monitoring CoWin vaccination slot availability.
  • 😵 spurdify: Python library that converts text into Spurdo-style nonsense.

OSS I Contribute To

  • 🦞 OpenClaw (~383k ⭐): Personal AI assistant across platforms; one of the main projects I maintain and contribute to.
  • 📈 openclaw-rtt: Round-trip-timing harness and auto-published dashboard measuring real agent reply latency across Discord, Telegram, Slack, and WhatsApp.
  • 🧰 clawhub: Skill and plugin registry for OpenClaw.
  • ⚛️ AliceO2Group/Control: ALICE experiment control system; part of my CERN / GSoC work.
  • ⚡ Bun: JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager.
  • 🤖 Codex: OpenAI's terminal coding agent.

Feel free to reach out to me on hi @ obviy.us!

item.description:
abdel

    Curated resources for JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture) world models and self-supervised learning

    Rust implementation of Attention Residuals from MoonshotAI/Kimi

    A curated list of AI safety resources: alignment, interpretability, governance, verification, and responsible deployment of frontier AI systems.

Abdel

Head of Applied AI & Verifiable Intelligence — StarkWare

World models · AI safety · verifiable computation.
Closing the gap between what autonomous systems claim and what can be proven.

What I do

  • Co-author and technical champion of EIP-1559 — the fee-market mechanism now securing Ethereum mainnet.
  • Head of Applied AI & Verifiable Intelligence at StarkWare — applying STARK proofs to AI integrity, inference, and settlement.
  • Former Ethereum protocol engineer (ConsenSys / PegaSys). 15+ years shipping production systems across payments, embedded security, cryptography, and blockchain.
  • Originated Kakarot (zkEVM in Cairo) and Madara (Starknet sequencer) from zero; both now run with independent teams. Bootstrapped 15+ open-source projects and grew the Starknet developer ecosystem to thousands.
  • Co-inventor, French patent FR 2 996 663 A1.

The question that drives the current work:

How do you verify what an autonomous system actually did?

Research

Peer-reproducible reports and preprints. Full record on ORCID.

  • Toward High-Assurance AI: Safety by Design for Autonomous Systems (2026) — A framework for treating verification as a first-class system property rather than a post-hoc add-on. → 10.5281/zenodo.20512718
  • CodeLeWM: A Reproducible, Claim-Gated Code World-Model Study with Negative Action-Use Results and a Narrow Downstream Reranking Slice (2026) — We study whether a JEPA-style latent code world-model can rerank candidate program edits without executing them, scoring candidates by predicted latent transitions rather than by generating patches. → 10.5281/zenodo.20630120 · code: CodeLeWM
  • Frozen-Backbone JEPA-Style Probes on HAM10000 (2026) — A nine-experiment ablation testing whether a latent predictor over a frozen vision encoder generalises on a leakage-controlled dermoscopy proxy; published with a full pretraining-contamination audit and an explicit "what is not yet claimed" boundary. → 10.5281/zenodo.20556968 · code: derma-jepa
  • Patch-Token Geometry of Four Released Vision Encoders (2026) — A multi-dataset artifact study comparing the patch-token representation geometry of DINOv2, I-JEPA, V-JEPA 2, and EUPE. → 10.5281/zenodo.20048509 · code: latent-inspector
  • The Half-Life of Trust (2026) — Why durable AI verification needs mathematics-rooted, post-quantum foundations rather than hardware-rooted trust (TEEs). → 10.5281/zenodo.19682195

Selected work

World models & physical AI

Project What it is
worldforge Testable world-model workflows for physical-AI systems: providers, planning, evaluation, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
ProvableWorldModel A commit-and-audit proof system for deterministic, quantized inference of a JEPA-style world model (LeWorldModel).
Lensemble Federated, end-to-end JEPA world models trained across mutually-distrusting data silos — with a roadmap to STARK-based proof of each participant's contribution.
GenoLeWM Action-conditioned JEPA world model for genomic edits: treat a DNA edit as an action over a frozen DNA encoder and predict the latent outcome.
CodeLeWM Latent transition models over code edits — a scorer/reranker for candidate patches, not a generator. Published as infrastructure plus an honest negative result.
derma-jepa Frozen-backbone JEPA-style probes on HAM10000: can a latent predictor distinguish stable lesions from changing ones under nuisance variation? Contamination-audited.
gpc_rs Generative robot policies in Rust: diffusion policy + world model + evaluator.
asimov-sim-lab Schema-backed inspection, validation, and deterministic evidence packaging for the Asimov v1 MuJoCo humanoid model.
mosaicmem Geometry-aware spatial memory for camera-controlled video generation.

Representation learning & ML systems

Project What it is
jepa-rs Rust implementation of JEPA primitives: I-JEPA, V-JEPA, C-JEPA, VICReg, EMA.
latent-inspector Compare DINOv2, I-JEPA, V-JEPA 2, and EUPE representation geometry on the same image. Rust + ONNX.
latent-inspector-py Patch-token geometry benchmarks for released vision encoders (DINOv2, I-JEPA, V-JEPA 2, EUPE).
attnres Attention residual stream experiments inspired by Kimi / MoonshotAI.
turboquant Rust implementation of Google's TurboQuant for KV-cache quantization.
nostrain Coordinator-free distributed ML training over Nostr relays using DiLoCo.
jepa-notebooks Interactive notebooks for JEPA architectures.

AI safety & verifiable inference

Deployment is moving faster than the verification layer. That gap is the work.

Project What it is
llm-provable-computer Verifiable LLM inference with STARKs.
awesome-ai-safety Curated map of AI safety tooling: alignment, interpretability, red teaming, formal verification, zkML, governance.
eu-ai-act-toolkit Open-source toolkit for EU AI Act compliance.
claude-md-compiler Compiles CLAUDE.md into a versioned policy lockfile and enforces it against diffs, hooks, and CI.

Zero-knowledge & Starknet infrastructure

Project What it is
Kakarot EVM interpreter in Cairo. Ethereum compatibility on Starknet via ZK proofs.
Madara Starknet sequencer for sovereign appchains.
Raito Bitcoin ZK client in Cairo. Verifies Bitcoin consensus inside a STARK proof.
Askeladd Verifiable computation for Nostr Data Vending Machines via STARKs.
Cashu ZK Engine Blind Diffie-Hellman key exchange in Cairo for Cashu ecash.

Bitcoin & freedom tech

Project What it is
collidervm ColliderVM: stateful computation on Bitcoin without fraud proofs.
bitcoin-mcp Bitcoin and Lightning MCP server.
nostringer-rs Ring signatures for Nostr, in Rust.
nostr-mcp Nostr MCP server.
bitcoin-honeybadger Agent-based modeling for Bitcoin network resilience.

Applied AI tooling

Project What it is
parler Multilingual voice intelligence on Mistral Voxtral — structured decision logs from French/English meetings.

Writing

Title What it is
Provable World Model World models, the integrity gap, and the fork in the road.
World Models, From Zero to Hero A field guide to one of the most overloaded terms in AI.
The Half-Life of Trust Why verifiable AI needs post-quantum foundations.
Math Is Humanity's Last Bastion Against Skynet Why ZK proofs are the foundation for AI safety at scale.
Can LLMs Be Provable Computers? Verifiable AI inference via STARKs.
Before Fighting Banks, Let's Understand How They Actually Work A cypherpunk's guide to the financial system.
Time to Take the Nostr Pill Why Nostr matters for freedom of speech.
Nostr DVMs Meet Verifiable Computation STARKs for trustless Nostr services.
Cashu Meets STARKs Zero-knowledge proofs for the Cashu protocol.

Earlier work

Hellhound — applied cryptography / blind computation (2018)

I co-founded Hellhound inside ConsenSys R&D: a decentralized blind-computation platform for running programs over homomorphically encrypted inputs without exposing the data to the network.

I built the HHVM register-based bytecode VM, the Paillier homomorphic-encryption pipeline, the Kubernetes/GKE infrastructure, the Ethereum smart contracts for on-chain computation proofs, and the consensus logic for detecting malicious nodes. I was also first author of the Red Paper.

We shipped a live demo at DevCon4 Prague.

Principle

Close the gap between what systems claim and what can be verified.

Math scales. Goodwill doesn't.

Hi there, I'm Leyang 👋

For the full personal homepage, visit https://lifeos.vip/about. Quick links: GitHub / Blog EN / Blog 中文 / Podcast EN / Podcast 中文. Product sites use /zh for Chinese pages.

Chief Vibe Officer at Midscene & builder of Vibelet, Aino, Tabbit, Pawgic, LifeOS, Calendar Pro, DeepAsk, Remosidian, and Doubao Say.

Focused on UI Automation and PKM, dedicated to maximizing productivity across work and life with AI.

🚀 Featured Projects

🤖 Midscene

AI-powered UI automation that stays debuggable.

Midscene is a framework for controlling Playwright, Puppeteer, and Android devices with natural language, visual reports, playground debugging, YAML scripts, and a JavaScript SDK.

  • Natural Language Interaction: Control web pages and devices using prompts such as "Tweet Hello World".
  • Visualization: Visualized reports make prompt tuning and failure analysis inspectable.
  • Flexible Usage: Supports code-first SDK usage and codeless YAML automation flows.
  • Scale: 13k GitHub stars.

📱 Vibelet

AI coding from your phone.

Vibelet is a mobile remote for Claude and Codex sessions: send prompts, review diffs, approve tool calls, and resume work while the daemon keeps running on your own machine.

  • Multi-agent Control: Controls Claude and Codex side by side, each agent in its own workspace.
  • Fast Pairing: Pairs instantly with QR scanning, with remote-ready and LAN-only modes.
  • Mobile Workflow: Supports image sharing, file browsing, downloads, approvals, and session resume.
  • Scope: Built around Claude + Codex mobile control with QR pairing, LAN mode, and remote-ready mode.

📝 Aino

AI native note-taking app.

Aino LifeOS combines AI chat, Markdown editing, calendar planning, tasks, Pomodoro, habits, and life reviews into one native workspace for knowledge and daily execution.

  • AI Notes: Supports multi-model AI chat with note context, date ranges, and prompt templates.
  • Daily Execution: Includes Markdown editing, calendar views, task inbox, habits, and periodic reviews.
  • Downloads: Mobile / Desktop.

🐰 Tabbit

Switch by letter. Stay in flow.

Tabbit replaces the slow, sequential macOS app switcher with direct selection: hold Command, press Tab, then type an app's initial to jump straight to it.

  • Direct Selection: Selects running apps by their English or Pinyin initials, including repeated initials for precise choices.
  • Familiar Controls: Keeps Tab, Shift-Tab, and pointer controls while making direct jumps faster.
  • Private by Design: Runs locally on macOS without recording typed text, with a notarized Apple Silicon build.

🐾 Pawgic

Teach your Mac your muscle memory.

Pawgic brings keyboard remapping, mouse scrolling, and trackpad gestures into one native Mac app, so everyday input can match the way your hands already work.

  • Keyboard: Maps shortcuts and text-editing controls with app-aware rules.
  • Mouse: Adds smooth or reversed scrolling for ordinary mice without changing continuous trackpad input.
  • Trackpad: Offers configurable gestures for switching, window layout, tabs, and more.

🧠 LifeOS

A complete personal knowledge management system for Obsidian.

LifeOS is designed to bring certainty to life and work through structured management.

  • Methodology: Implements PARA and Periodic Notes systems.
  • Awards: Winner of Obsidian Gem Awards 2024 Bronze in Best Template Category.
  • Ecosystem: Includes advanced templates and automation using Dataview and Templater plugins.
  • Adoption: 1k open-source stars, 46k downloads, and 1000+ users.

📅 Calendar Pro

A serious planning layer for Obsidian.

Calendar Pro turns Obsidian tasks into a schedulable calendar system with month, week, day, agenda, kanban, timeline, and Eisenhower views, plus ICS and CalDAV sync.

  • Planning Views: Supports month, week, day, agenda, kanban, timeline, and four-quadrant planning.
  • Task Scheduling: Moves tasks between dates, time blocks, priorities, tags, and timelines.
  • Calendar Sync: Connects remote calendars with ICS and CalDAV, including iCloud and Google Calendar.

🔎 DeepAsk

AI chat across Obsidian and Chrome.

DeepAsk has two parallel surfaces: DeepAsk for Obsidian brings vault-aware AI chat into Obsidian, while DeepAsk for Chrome combines browser context with Obsidian context by calling the context exposed by the Obsidian plugin.

  • DeepAsk for Obsidian: Chat with notes, tags, files, and time-scoped vault context.
  • DeepAsk for Chrome: Combine browser context with Obsidian context for web tasks.
  • Shared Context: The Chrome extension can call the Obsidian context exposed by the plugin, so web tasks can use vault knowledge.

📲 Remosidian

Your phone is a remote, not a second vault.

Remosidian pairs a phone with a host running on your own computer so you can browse files, search notes, capture ideas, and ask local AI about your Obsidian vault while the vault stays on the host machine.

  • Local AI: Ask from your phone while Claude or Codex reads vault context on the paired host.
  • Remote Notes: Open folders, read Markdown, search notes, and capture ideas without syncing the whole vault elsewhere.
  • Flexible Host: Uses a CLI host or private Obsidian plugin host with QR pairing, LAN, relay, or stable-host setup.

🎙️ Doubao Say

Voice input built for Linux, Wayland, and Omarchy.

Doubao Say is an open-source GTK4 voice-input app powered by Doubao cloud recognition. Press a global shortcut, speak with live captions, optionally polish the transcript with an OpenAI-compatible model, and paste the final text into the active app.

  • Natural Input Flow: Supports tap-to-toggle, hold-to-talk, live captions, and double-tap Enter.
  • Optional AI Polish: Cleans up filler words, punctuation, and structure while preserving the speaker's meaning.
  • Omarchy Ready: Ships as a standalone Linux app and an optional Omarchy plugin, with semantic UI checks powered by Midscene in a real VM.
  • Open Source: Available on GitHub under the MIT license.

🛠 Tech Stack

  • Core Focus: PKM, AI Agents, UI Automation, Mobile AI Coding.
  • Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript.
  • Automation: Playwright, Puppeteer, Android, iOS.
  • PKM / Obsidian: Obsidian, Dataview, Templater, Milkdown.
  • Infrastructure / Protocols: Cloudflare Tunnel, MCP, CalDAV, ICS.
